The '''Karren spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Karren]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antiquity]]. It consisted of one building that was used for traffic control that was hexagonal shaped. The building was 30 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] across with a 10 meter high navigational beacon.<ref name="Free Time">{{WEGCite|story=Free Time|book=The Politics of Contraband}}</ref>
